subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What identity should the iOS app trust for a CA-valid Remote Domain endpoint whose reverse proxy or anycast service can present multiple legitimate leaf certificates?
rationale: Choosing between platform PKI, leaf or SPKI pin sets, and strict single-leaf pinning changes the security boundary and determines how existing persisted pins must migrate; source inspection cannot safely infer that product policy.

options.title: Split Trust By Route
options.body: Use platform CA and hostname validation for CA-valid Remote Domain endpoints, retain explicit pinning for self-signed or discovered private gateways, and migrate existing manual-domain pins after successful system validation.

options.title: Persist A Pin Set
options.body: Keep explicit pinning but store a bounded set of accepted leaf or SPKI identities with an intentional rotation and expiry policy.

options.title: Keep Strict Leaf Pinning
options.body: Continue requiring one exact leaf fingerprint and explicitly document Cloudflare anycast and rotating reverse proxies as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Split Trust By Route
recommendation.body: Use platform CA and hostname validation for CA-valid Remote Domain endpoints, retain explicit pinning for self-signed or discovered private gateways, and migrate existing manual-domain pins after successful system validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current certificate-rotation recovery behavior and are the closest historical owner of this exact decision surface.
